name: AABB Ray Distance
definition: Computes the distance along a ray direction from a given point to the nearest intersection with an axis-aligned bounding box (AABB). Returns -1 if the point is inside or the ray does not intersect.
summary: AABB Ray Distance computes the distance from a point to the nearest intersection with an axis-aligned bounding box, returning -1 if the point is inside or the ray points away.
